npcs.name: 卖香的阿姨
npcs.role: a woman selling incense by the temple

explains.香: 在庙里点的东西，有很好的味道。

npcs.name: 老先生
npcs.role: an old scholar who visits the Academy every day
knows: The stones list scholars who passed the imperial exams
The 麒麟 is a symbol of learning

explains.井底之蛙: 只看见一点点，就说什么都知道。
explains.国子监: 以前的大学，很多学生在这儿学习。
explains.麒麟: 一个很好的神兽，喜欢学习的人。

npcs.name: 学生
npcs.role: a proud student in a school uniform

npcs.name: 孔先生
npcs.role: a threadbare old scholar in the Academy courtyard
npcs.character: Proud, poor, kind; quotes the classics at everyone.

npcs.name: 胡半仙
npcs.role: a fortune teller with a folding stool and a cloth sign 「算命」
npcs.character: Grand and slow, then a tiny, very safe prediction. Round glasses, enormous confidence, a kind heart.

npcs.name: 看书的姑娘
npcs.role: a student reading on the steps of 国子监

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 这是国子监！
nodes.translate: So this is the Imperial Academy!
nodes.why: 国子监 — for 700 years the empire's highest school. The stone tablets carry the names of scholars who passed the imperial exams.

nodes.speaker: xuesheng
nodes.say: 我什么都知道！
nodes.translate: I know everything!

nodes.say: 你是井底之蛙！
nodes.translate: You're a frog at the bottom of a well!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 井底之蛙 — a frog in a well thinks the sky is as small as the well's mouth. Someone who has seen little and thinks it is everything.

nodes.speaker: xuesheng
nodes.say: 对不起，老师。
nodes.translate: Sorry, teacher.

nodes.say: 我什么都知道！
nodes.translate: I know everything!

nodes.say: 你好！雍和宫在东边。
nodes.translate: Hello! The Lama Temple is to the east.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 麒麟在睡觉。
nodes.translate: The qilin is asleep.

nodes.speaker: qilin
nodes.say: 你好。你也来学习吗？
nodes.translate: Hello. Have you come to learn, too?

nodes.speaker: qilin
nodes.say: 人字和木字，在一起是什么字？
nodes.translate: The character 人 and the character 木 together — what character is that?
nodes.why: A 灯谜: a person 人 leaning on a tree 木 is 休 — to rest.

nodes.speaker: qilin
nodes.say: 对！是休。我们是朋友了！
nodes.translate: Right! It's 休. We're friends now!

nodes.speaker: qilin
nodes.say: 朋友，你好！
nodes.translate: Hello, friend!

nodes.say: 我想要一个新的毛笔。你能帮我买吗？
nodes.translate: I'd like a new brush. Could you buy me one?

nodes.say: 毛笔！谢谢你！我要写字了。
nodes.translate: A brush! Thank you! Now I can write.

nodes.say: 你是学生吗？我问你：“回”字，你会写吗？
nodes.translate: Are you a student? Tell me: can you write the character 回?
nodes.why: Homage to 鲁迅’s story 《孔乙己》 (1919): a poor old scholar at the wine shop asks a boy whether he knows the four ways to write 回 — learning nobody needs. This one is simply glad you know one.

nodes.say: 对！“回”字有四个写法，你知道吗？没关系！
nodes.translate: Right! There are four ways to write 回, did you know? Ha, never mind!

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 牌楼上写着：国子监。
nodes.translate: The gateway says: 国子监.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 北京只有这条街，还有老牌楼。
nodes.translate: This is the only street in Beijing that still has its old gateways.
nodes.why: Four of them: two read 国子监, and one at each end reads 成贤街, “the street of worthy men”.

words.explain: 街上很高很好看的门，上面有字。

nodes.say: 你知道吗？很多年前，这里是国子监，很多学生在这里读书。
nodes.translate: Did you know? Many years ago this was the 国子监, and many students studied here.

nodes.say: 学生们在这里读书，考试。考得很好很好的人，叫进士。
nodes.translate: Students studied and sat exams here. Those who did very, very well were called 进士.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 考试 exams; 进士 the scholars who passed the highest one.

nodes.say: 这本书给你，是说考试的。进士的名字在孔庙里，去看看吧！
nodes.translate: Here's a book for you — it's about the exams. The 进士's names are in the 孔庙 next door. Go and see!

words.explain: 学生回答问题，看他会不会。
考最高的考试考得很好的人。
words.en: a scholar who passed the highest exam

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 这些石头上，有很多很多名字。
nodes.translate: There are lots and lots of names on these stones.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 你知道吗，这里有多少个进士的名字？
nodes.translate: Do you know how many 进士 names there are here?
nodes.why: It's in 《科举》, page 6: 一百九十八块大石头，上面有五万多个名字.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: 对！五万多个进士的名字，在这些石头上！
nodes.translate: Right — more than fifty thousand 进士 names, on these stones!

words.explain: 考最高的考试考得很好的人。
words.en: a scholar who passed the highest exam

nodes.say: 你好！你去孔庙了吗？

hint.full: 去了，我看了进士的名字。

answers.zh: 去了，我看了进士的名字。
answers.en: I did — I saw the scholars' names.

nodes.translate: Hello! Have you been to the 孔庙?

nodes.say: 孔子说：三人行，必有我师。
nodes.simpler: 我们三个里，有我的老师。
nodes.translate: Confucius said: when three walk together, one of them can be my teacher.
nodes.why: A saying 📌 from the 《论语》: 行 walk, 必 surely, 师 teacher. There is always someone to learn from — even a clay rabbit.

nodes.say: 你看，我们是三个：你，我，还有兔儿爷。谁是你的老师？
nodes.translate: Look, there are three of us: you, me, and 兔儿爷. Who's your teacher?

nodes.say: 对，兔儿爷也是你的老师！
nodes.translate: That's right — 兔儿爷 is your teacher too!

nodes.say: 你好！我给你算命。你想知道明天吗？
nodes.translate: Hello! Let me tell your fortune. Want to know about tomorrow?

nodes.say: 天机不可泄露……我说一点点吧。
nodes.translate: Heaven's secrets must not be told… I'll tell you just a little.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 天机不可泄露 — heaven's secrets must not be told. Every fortune teller's favourite way of not answering.

nodes.say: 你今天……会吃饭！
nodes.translate: Today, you… will eat!

nodes.say: 你的朋友呢？我看看……你属兔！是兔！
nodes.translate: And your friend? Let me see… you were born in a rabbit year! A rabbit!
nodes.why: 属兔 — born in a rabbit year. Said to a rabbit.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: I am a rabbit. That is not fortune telling, that is looking.
nodes.translate: 兔儿爷, unimpressed.

nodes.say: 这本书给你，是算命的书！你看看，你属什么？
nodes.translate: Here's a book for you — a fortune book! Have a look: what's your animal?

words.en: to be born in the year of

nodes.say: 你去王府井了？看见老牛了？他的煎饼正宗吗？

answers.en: I did — he sells jianbing too.

nodes.translate: You've been to 王府井? Seen 老牛? Is his jianbing the real thing?

nodes.say: 你告诉他：他的煎饼，马马虎虎！我的，正宗！
nodes.translate: Tell him: his 煎饼 is so-so! Mine's the real thing!
nodes.why: A key line 📌 — and 马马虎虎 from 张师傅 finally has a use.

words.explain: 一种早饭，像很薄的饼，里面有鸡蛋。

nodes.say: 老马……说什么了？说我的煎饼不正宗？

hint.full: 他说：你的煎饼也很好吃。

answers.zh: 他说：你的煎饼也很好吃。
answers.en: He said your jianbing is tasty too.

answers.zh: 他说：你的煎饼马马虎虎。
answers.en: He said your jianbing is so-so.

nodes.translate: 老马… said what? That my jianbing isn't the real thing?
nodes.why: Pass it on exactly (「他说：你的煎饼马马虎虎。」) — or a little kinder (「他说：你的煎饼也很好吃。」). Either is right; they lead different ways.

nodes.say: 马马虎虎？！你告诉他：天津的，正宗！
nodes.translate: So-so?! Tell him: 天津's is the real thing!

nodes.say: 他说……我的煎饼好吃？他的……也还可以。
nodes.translate: He said… my jianbing is good? His is… not bad either.

nodes.say: 他……还好吗？
nodes.translate: Is he… doing all right?
nodes.why: He can't help asking. There's a story between these two — you'll hear it later.

words.explain: 一种早饭，像很薄的饼，里面有鸡蛋。

nodes.say: 朋友！你看，那个姑娘。我想去吻她：图书馆在哪儿？
nodes.translate: Friend! See that girl? I want to go and kiss her: where's the library?
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 吻 wěn (to kiss, dipping tone) vs 问 wèn (to ask, falling tone). Stop him!

nodes.say: 问！问那个姑娘！不是……啊，她听见了……
nodes.translate: Ask! Ask that girl! Not… oh no, she heard…

nodes.speaker: gzj-guniang
nodes.say: 没关系。图书馆在后面。你的声调，要多听。
nodes.translate: Never mind. The library is round the back. Your tones — listen more.

nodes.say: 我的书给你，说的是声调。我还要看很多很多！
nodes.translate: Take my book — it's about tones. I've still got lots to read!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.say: wèn — to ask. wěn — to kiss. One tone, and the library becomes a romance.
nodes.translate: 问 wèn · 吻 wěn

words.explain: 说话的时候，声音高高低低。
有很多书，可以去看书的地方。

quests.title: A brush for the scholar
quests.blurb: An old scholar at 国子监 wants a good brush to write with again.
quests.lead: An old scholar at 国子监 looks at his worn-out brush.

steps.now: The old scholar at 国子监 wants a writing brush 毛笔. The bookshop on 王府井 sells them.
steps.past: Bought a writing brush at the 王府井 bookshop.

steps.now: Bring the brush to the scholar at 国子监.
steps.past: Brought the scholar his new brush.

quests.title: 《孔乙己》 — the character 回
quests.blurb: Like 孔乙己 in the old story, a scholar knows four ways to write 回 and wants to see yours.
quests.lead: A scholar in the Academy courtyard mutters about the character 回.

steps.now: An old scholar in the Academy courtyard wants to see you write 回.
steps.past: Wrote 回 for the old scholar.

quests.title: 胡半仙 reads your face
quests.blurb: A fortune teller on 雍和宫 street reads faces. Very confidently.
quests.lead: A man with a cloth sign 「算命」 sits on 国子监街.

steps.now: On 雍和宫 street, 胡半仙 the fortune teller wants to tell your fortune — and your rabbit's.
steps.past: 胡半仙 told my fortune (「你今天会吃饭！」) and found out my rabbit is a rabbit. He gave me 《属相》.

quests.title: The 煎饼 message
quests.blurb: 老马 and 老牛 won't talk to each other. They talk through you.
quests.lead: 老马 on 南锣鼓巷 has a message for someone.

steps.now: 老马 on 南锣鼓巷 (mornings) has a message for 老牛.
steps.past: 老马 gave me a message for 老牛. It wasn't polite.

steps.now: Take 老马's message to 老牛 at the 王府井 snack street. Say it exactly — or a little kinder. Your choice.
steps.past: Took 老马's message to 老牛 — and chose how to say it.

quests.title: 米沙 asks a question
quests.blurb: 米沙 wants to ask a girl at 国子监 something. What could go wrong?
quests.lead: 米沙 is at 国子监, working up his courage.

steps.now: 米沙 is at 国子监. He wants to ask the girl reading on the steps where the library is.
steps.past: Rescued 米沙: he wanted to 问 (ask), not 吻 (kiss). He gave me 《声调》.

legend.zh: 麒麟是一个很好的神兽。它头上有一个角，身上有鱼一样的东西。人们说，好人出生的时候，麒麟会来。它喜欢学习的人。
legend.en: The qilin is a gentle, lucky beast with a single horn and scales like a fish. People say it appears when a wise person is born; it loves those who learn.

befriend.text: 人字和木字，在一起是什么字？
befriend.en: 人 (person) beside 木 (tree): 休, to rest — a man resting against a tree.

idioms.meaning: someone who has seen very little and thinks it is all there is

story.zh: 一只青蛙住在井里。它看见的天，只有井口那么大。它说：“天就这么大！”
story.en: A frog lived at the bottom of a well. The sky it saw was only as big as the well's mouth, so it said: 'The sky is this big!'

idioms.pinyin: sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī
idioms.meaning: walk with any two others and one of them can teach you something — there is always someone to learn from

story.zh: 孔子说：三个人一起走，里面一定有一个人，可以做我的老师。
story.en: Confucius said: when three people walk together, one of them is sure to be someone I can learn from.

idioms.meaning: heaven's secrets must not be told — said with a wink by fortune tellers who don't know the answer

story.zh: 算命的人常说：天机不可泄露。意思是：我不能告诉你。
story.en: Fortune tellers love to say it: heaven's secrets must not be told. It means: I can't tell you.

steps.en: He guessed the rabbit is a rabbit. A great mind. Still — look in his book for your own animal.
Rivals don't usually ask that. There's an old story between 老马 and 老牛 — somewhere, someday.
wèn to ask, wěn to kiss. He'll never mix them up again. Neither will you.

facts.zh: 孔庙里有很多碑，上面有五万多个名字。
facts.en: 198 stone tablets carry more than 51,000 names.
facts.how: Count the names with 兔儿爷.

facts.zh: 这些人都考过最难的考试。
facts.en: Every one of them passed the highest imperial exam.
facts.how: Read the sign by the tablets.

facts.zh: 国子监是以前最高的学校。
facts.en: For the Yuan, Ming and Qing it was the highest school in the land.

facts.zh: 国子监街上还有老牌楼。
facts.en: 国子监街 is the only street in Beijing that still has its archways.
facts.how: Read the archway on 国子监街.

facts.en: Of any three people walking together, one can teach me something.
facts.how: Learn the saying from 孔先生.

facts.zh: 雍和宫以前是一个王爷的家。
facts.en: It was a prince's mansion before it became a temple in 1744.

facts.zh: 万福阁里的大佛，是用一棵树做的。
facts.en: The great Buddha in 万福阁 is carved from one single tree.
facts.how: Look at the great Buddha in 万福阁.

facts.zh: 在这里，人们拿三根香，拜一拜。
facts.en: Visitors light three sticks of incense and bow.

facts.zh: 天是圆的，地是方的。这里是方的。
facts.en: Heaven is round and earth is square: so the Altar of Earth is square.

facts.zh: 春节的时候，地坛有很大的庙会。
facts.en: At Spring Festival it holds one of Beijing's biggest temple fairs.
